info.title: Foundational Data Manager API
info.description:
This API gives remote programmatic access to FDM data. An Active Directory account is required which must be added to a FDM Authorization Group in order to access endpoints.

All FDM endpoints require the system to first authenticate. To get started, read the /Users/Login endpoint, which will generate a Bearer authentication token that is required for all other API endpoints. From this documentation, you can enter the Bearer token using the Authorize button in the top right, then you can test other endpoints you are authorized for.

When making your own requests, the following HTTP headers should be added to your requests:

  • Authorization: Bearer {Token}
  • Accept: application/json

get.summary: Search all downloaded specifications by date or type criteria.
get.description:
At least one search criteria must be provided, however all parameters are optional. Provide criteria through query parameters.

Examples:
  • /specifications/search?types=Finished Product Part&types=Formulation Part - Lists all FPPs and FOPs.
  • /specifications/search?modified.gt=2021-03-01&types=Finished Product Part - Lists all FPPs with an Enovia modified date after 03/01/2021.
  • /specifications/search?lastDownload.gt=2021-03-01&lastDownload.lt=2021-04-01 - Lists all specifications downloaded in the month of March.
  • /specifications/search?initialDownload.lt=2021-01-01&types=Raw Material - Lists Raw Materials that were first downloaded before 2021.
